prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished comparison concept board showing SIX NEW variants derived ONLY from A3 / TERRACE, the TOP-RIGHT character in the reference sheet. User selected A3 and requests six variants, AT LEAST THREE WITHOUT GOGGLES. Mandatory: TOP ROW three with forehead goggles; BOTTOM ROW three completely WITHOUT ANY GOGGLES, glasses, lenses, empty goggle frames, optical brow pods, sunglasses or replacement visors. The bottom row has unobstructed simple dark faces with exactly two cyan capsule eyes beneath sculpted ivory architectural brows.

Reference image role: design reference only. Follow TOP-RIGHT A3's identity: floating head-only Copilot, inverted trapezoid tapered lower frame, THREE broad offset ivory roof tiers giving a terraced skyline, overlapping diagonal ivory cheek plates, faceted deep-teal rear shell, navy face and TWO bright vertical cyan capsule eyes. No mouth. Small orange crown tab and small orange chin detail; small white schematic-plan emblem on visible teal side panel. Matte ivory/teal/navy/cyan/orange palette identical across variants. No body, arms, legs, feet, neck, hats, giant compass, miniature buildings or extra props. Roof layers and cheeks are the actual core frame. Keep friendly, clever, composed personality. Low-poly deliberate planes, crisp broad bevels, clean studio light and soft hovering shadow.

LANDSCAPE 3:2 canvas, spacious 3-column by 2-row board, large objects matching camera angle and apparent scale, front-left three-quarter facing PAGE LEFT, models occupy about 75% cell. Dark navy background, thin subtle separators. Top title 'ARCHITECT COPILOT — TERRACE VARIANTS'. Only six short labels and descriptions below models, no marketing slogans or extra panels. Number T1 T2 T3 across top; T4 T5 T6 bottom. Each is a genuinely different Terrace design, not identical copies with optics toggled.

T1 / STACK — description 'Compact tiers • goggles'. Tight compact interpretation of A3, exactly three thick broad roof steps swept back, two diagonal overlapping cheek plates each side, paired thick chamfered rectangular forehead goggles seated at front roof lip. Confident compact proportions.

T2 / CASCADE — description 'Flowing layers • goggles'. Roof layers descend continuously into layered rear cheek panels like an architectural cascade; ivory edges step progressively down and back, narrower chin, taller and more tapered overall. Paired softly trapezoidal goggles smaller and nestled inside upper ivory lip. A3 family still clear, not a dome.

T3 / CORBEL — description 'Wide shoulders • goggles'. Low broad Terrace head, heavy stepped upper shoulder blocks, roof tiers project slightly sideways symmetrically, three inward-stepping cheek segments frame a broad dark face. Wide paired polygonal forehead goggles, chunky deep-teal central bridge. Sturdy architectural bracket construction, no single long cantilever.

T4 / OPEN PLAN — description 'Clear expression • no goggles'. COMPLETELY NO GOGGLES. Clean uninterrupted navy trapezoid face extends upward directly under a simple thick ivory brow lip. Three crisp shallow roof tiers remain visible. Two bright cyan capsule eyes a bit higher in face to feel awake. Two broad elegant diagonal ivory cheeks with only one overlap seam. Open, clean and friendly. Nothing resembling two optical recesses above eyes.

T5 / SKYLIGHT — description 'Split crown • no goggles'. COMPLETELY NO GOGGLES. Tallish terraced core with three roof steps split at center by ONE narrow recessed cyan architectural light channel running front-to-back; channel is on roof, not an eye or visor. Navy face beneath a continuous unbroken ivory brow. Flanking ivory cheek rails contain one slim vertical cutout each. Exactly two cyan eyes within large clear face, small orange chin. Airy precise construction and distinctive split crown.

T6 / PAVILION — description 'Sheltered face • no goggles'. COMPLETELY NO GOGGLES. Broad short head with three flattened roof tiers and deep symmetric front brow eave, a welcoming dark navy face tucked below roof. Paired diagonal cheek pillars are shorter and heavier at shoulders, taper into a small ivory chin beam; side panels large and faceted teal. Two cyan eyes positioned centrally with ample dark face around. Roof defines character silhouette, no optics of any kind except the two facial eye marks.

Final checks: SIX heads total. Top row exactly three with goggles. Bottom row EXACTLY THREE visibly goggles-free heads, no hidden/stowed goggles anywhere. All six keep terraced A3 roof and layered frame heritage. Preserve two facial eyes each, meaningful core shape differences, consistent palette, clean readable labels, comfortable margins and no clipping.
